note: Twenty interleaved pairs on one host. The candidate decodes uncompressed records that have no headers and one- or two-byte length fields by slicing the batch. Other shapes still use the generic reader. Every run verified 20,000 records and validation_failures stayed 0. Allocation count stayed 135,370. The paired mean records/s ratio is 1.087 and the bootstrap 95% CI is 1.050 to 1.126. Two of the twenty pairs were slower. Not a fetch comparison against other clients and not a fastest-client result.
